author: Monarchic / Codex
compositionScope: Eight independently composed procedural graphic building blocks. Current revision 3 reworks OL-02, OL-04, OL-06 and OL-08; OL-01, OL-03, OL-05 and OL-07 retain their previous compositions. No study was deleted. Catalog influences inform material, texture and composition principles rather than copied forms.
responsiveScope: One set of mode/palette controls is inherited by Desktop 1200 and Phone 390. Artwork fills the available width after padding. Nominal overlay-scrollbar widths are 1080/350; observed classic-scrollbar Preview artwork is 1065×680 and 335×280 with a 15px scrollbar. Local GPU phase sampling separately uses 960×600 and 350×280. These are responsive graphic studies rather than a production UI.
intentionalDifferences: Exploratory graphic objects; style calibration awaits the owner's feedback.
The principal OL-07 letterforms are locally constructed geometric strokes; small factual labels use platform monospace fallbacks.
The optical material is an authored refraction/reflection approximation, not a spectral path tracer.
Export and thumbnail behavior is covered by runtime tests; actual Framer exported images have not been reviewed.
OL-07 retains an inherited Mouse-control limitation: changing the generic toggle does not alter its glyph image. Its protected composition and controls were retained.

runtimeResourcePolicy.scope: one browser window / JavaScript realm shared with the five source-led families
runtimeResourcePolicy.exportAndThumbnail: Generated frozen frame at Still time; temporary GPU disposed.

localGPU.scope: Actual local WebGL renderer factories sampled serially. Original graphics at desktop960x600 and phone350x280 across phases0/8/16, plus all28 original/retained modes at one desktop phase. Not an actual Framer Preview, editor persistence or exported-image inspection.

previousSavedVerification.proofScope: Independent fresh main reads verify both new code files, all 24 new controls/classification/stored constraints and unchanged existing source/native/original work. MCP intrinsic placeholder rectangles do not establish final fractional-width layout; operator browser evidence separately confirms editor reload and actual Desktop/Phone Preview. Local GPU evidence samples eight originals at three phases in two aspects plus all 28 modes at one desktop phase. These are independent original studies, not source-video/algorithm reconstructions. Actual exported images, publication and production integration are not verified.

previousIntentionalDifferences: Exploratory graphic objects, not approved brand marks or implemented interface behavior.
The generated type atlas uses system sans-serif fallbacks; letterforms can vary by platform.
Frozen export/thumbnail behavior is covered by runtime tests; actual Framer exported images have not been reviewed.
